changes.edit: Apply agreement-room and dollar-calibration wording
changes.before: with about $220 of room in a typical negotiation, any effect is below about $2 per deal.
changes.after: with a mean of $222.47 of room for agreement, the larger absolute 90% interval bound corresponds to about $1.70 per deal.

changes.edit: Apply Bonferroni count/threshold and p-values
changes.before: The two main ultimatum results would remain significant even under this stricter threshold, although this check was not part of our pre-registration.
changes.after: Both main ultimatum results remain significant at the corrected threshold of 0.05/29 ≈ 0.00172 (p ≈ 0.00010 and 0.00040), although this check was not part of our pre-registration.

changes.edit: Correct proposer interval rounding
Clarify scored comprehension conditions
changes.before: every model answered correctly in all 20 calls for every card.
changes.after: every model answered correctly in all 20 calls for each of the three scored cards; “not disclosed” answers were unsure and unscored.

changes.edit: Use approved descriptive S1 language
changes.before: The lower offers are fully explained by lower expectations: agents act as if a human will accept less.
changes.after: After controlling for stated expectations, the offer contrast is near zero (+$0.08); this is a descriptive association, not a causal explanation.

changes.edit: Disclose approved post-registration mechanical patch
changes.before: The logs of every API call were frozen before analysis, and rerunning the analysis from them reproduces every table and figure exactly.
changes.after: The logs of every API call were frozen before analysis, and rerunning the analysis from them reproduces every table and figure exactly. After registration, an approved mechanical patch enabled the Study 2 main run and recorded both registration and execution commits; the analysis, prompts and scoring were unchanged.

changes.after: - Author-approved room-for-agreement calibration: the actual mean of (b − s) over all 960 main Study 2 episodes is $222.46875; multiplying by the larger absolute 90% bound, 0.007658102208929781, gives $1.7036884257928472. The paper reports $222.47 and about $1.70.

changes.edit: Update excluded notes: verified Bonferroni check

changes.after: - Bonferroni check verified: 29 pooled secondary tests; threshold 0.05/29 ≈ 0.00172414; both main ultimatum p-values clear it. This check remains explicitly non-preregistered.
